notes.title: Update for utility and for better gameplay
notes.notes:
Hi Smasher.

Time flies by so quickly that it's been 10 days since the launch of Early Access.
In fact, the developer team has secretly improved some of the details in the game.
We had made some improvements so that we wouldn't be exposed, but this change would be exposed as expected.

So we will tell you the secrets before you find out.
Let's go.

[h2]Updated list[/h2][list]
[*]We've optimized the difficulty level.
[*]Improved the ability to adjust the direction of the standing position and the position of the box's appearance.
[/list]

[h2]We've optimized the difficulty level.[/h2][list]
[*]NORMAL - For those who want to do casual exercise on a daily basis
[*]HARD - For those who want to lose weight and strengthen their bodies
[*]OPTION- Continue to the details below
[/list]

[h3]About OPTION[/h3][list]
[*]NightCore - Adjust the speed of the song. The default is 1x speed.
[*]BoostMode - Forces the number of boxes to increase the appearance. Therefore, there are more parts that are out of sync with the rhythm, but the box is put out so that you can play with slow music and folk songs. But you can't do the classics. The default value is off and disabled.
[/list]

In summary, if you want to do daily training while riding the rhythm, you should play HARD + NightCore or HARD + 1x speed.

If you want to do more aerobic exercise, turn BoostMode on in HARD. Rather than getting into a rhythm, you'll be punching the box with your reflexes more often, getting closer to an actual boxing exercise. 

Anyway, now you are able to choose more clearly whether you want to sweat to the rhythm or work out more like Rocky.

Keep healthy!
